column1: # Projects known to setup sync. Tab-separated: name, mac_path, desktop_path, memory, claude_md.
# memory: the Mac memory folder under ~/.claude/projects this project uses ("-" for none);
#   on the desktop, sync.sh links the desktop folder's memory to it, so both machines share notes.
# claude_md: yes = the project's CLAUDE.md is copied to ~/.claude/project-docs/<name>/ and synced.
# Edit desktop_path if a project lives somewhere else on the desktop, then run sync.sh links.
